root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: the `if (!str[i]) break;` condition must become true before `gf_strdup(str)` may execute
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Immediately after the first `dimC` string copy loop and before `gf_strdup(str)`, `dimC_box_read()` must know that the loop satisfied its explicit `if (!str[i]) break;` terminator condition rather than exhausting the fixed `str` buffer on nonzero bytes.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original records `terminator_seen=0` at the post-loop guard and still executes the protected `gf_strdup(str)` call, so the 1024-byte stack buffer is forwarded without any observed NUL terminator. The fixed original is guarded on the saved witness, and the adjacent boundary perturbation `first_string_nul_at_stack_boundary` executes the same protected call with `terminator_seen=1`, providing the genuine fixed-side witness.

nodes.state: At the selected first-string sink, `gf_strdup(str)` receives the same `str` buffer from `dimC_box_read()` and therefore applies C-string semantics to that buffer.
At the post-loop guard, `i` equals the fixed `str` capacity, so the vulnerable execution has overwritten every byte of `char str[1024]` with nonzero input before considering `gf_strdup`.

edges.relation: The exact `str` buffer that survives the vulnerable first-string guard is passed unchanged into `gf_strdup` as its argument.
